_read_this_first: Six value sets a consumer copies from the hub's boundary rather than mints (kogaki#1205; the boundary-field rule, product-lab@4cc496b topics/knowledge-architecture.md:50: 'a consumer owns the SHAPE of its own record and NEVER the VALUES of a field that exists to join across the boundary'). check-consult-receipts.sh and check-boundary-receipts.sh read this file at run time rather than holding these as literals; check-kit-currency.sh compares each entry's `value` against the gateway's `boundary_values` tool (tsurezure-gateway#123) and reports agreement or drift by name. Each entry's `pin` is the hub citation the value was copied from — the provenance a kit edit here must carry, never invent.
